# external/zenodo/

Put the data package of Kim et al. (2026), Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.21400071 (CC BY 4.0), here: unzip `2_evaluation.zip` to
`external/zenodo/raw/2_evaluation/` (the file used is `raw/2_evaluation/3_evaluation/all_model_predictions_same_ytrue.npz`). Not tracked. `scripts/zenodo_xy_from_package.py` and `scripts/validate_metrics_authors.py` read it.
